title: Extension Magic - Lovable
content: Extension Magic Previewing last saved version Preview Share Upgrade Publish 7 Mar at 12:53 is lovable good for web extension creation? Lovable is designed for building web applications (React + Vite + Tailwind), not browser extensions directly. Browser extensions require specific manifest files, background scripts, and content scripts that fall outside Lovable's architecture. However, you could use Lovable to build the popup UI or options page of an extension, then export the code via GitHub and add the extension-specific files (manifest.json, background.js, etc.) in your own editor. For a full extension workflow, a traditional code editor would be more suitable. Lovable is designed for building web applications (React + Vite + Tailwind), not browser extensions directly.
